definitions.full: H3643. Kimham כִּמְהָם proper name, masculine 1. attendant of David 2Sam 19:38 ; 19:39 = כִּמְהָן v. 19:41 ; ᵐ5 in all Ξιμααμ , ᵐ5 L Αχιμααμ . 2 in noun, of location כִמְהָם גֵּרוּת Jer 41:17 Qr (Kt כמוהם ), compare גֵּרוּת above כִּמְהָן 2Sam 19:41 , see foregoing. כַּמָּה see מָה . כְּמוֺ see below כְּ p.455 above כמוהם Jer 41:17 Kt, see כִּמְהָם .

occurrences.englishText: The king answered, “Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good to you. Whatever you request of me, that I will do for you.”
All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned to his own place.

Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away, and brought the king, and his household, over the Jordan, and all David’s men with him?”
They departed and lived in Geruth Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt
